description: Find discount prices with a free reusable ClixRx savings card. Retrieves or issues the session card with codes and view/print links. Comparisons cover returned offers only, not market-wide lowest prices. This does not purchase medication, select a pharmacy, or send a message.

card_session_id.description: Private UUID for this conversation. Reuse the returned cardSessionId or the UUID already used. For a new conversation with no prior issuance attempt, generate one UUID internally before the first price or card call. Never ask the customer for it or replace it after uncertain issuance.

dosage_form.description: Dosage form explicitly supplied in the current user turn, e.g. "tablet"; never infer from memory

drug_name.description: Medication explicitly requested in the current user turn — brand or generic, misspellings OK; never infer from memory

existing_card_reference.description: Existing ClixRx card or coupon share reference, when available. Reuse the existing card instead of issuing another; never invent a reference.

formulation.description: Which product to price when both exist for the same strength and form. Omit to price the generic (what most prescriptions allow). Pass 'brand' only when the customer says their prescription is brand-only or dispense as written, or explicitly asks for the brand price. Never ask the customer to look this up; the pharmacist fills what the prescription allows.

quantity.description: Exact dispensed quantity explicitly supplied in the current user turn, positive and at most 360 (fractions allowed); ask when absent and never infer or assume it. Do not carry over another medication's quantity.

strength.description: Strength explicitly supplied in the current user turn, e.g. "10 mg"; never infer from memory

use_approximate_location.description: Set true only when the customer explicitly asks to use their current/approximate location; returns a ZIP suggestion that still requires confirmation before pricing

zip_code.description: Five-digit US ZIP explicitly supplied or confirmed in the current user turn; never infer from profile or memory

name: find_prescription_discount_prices
title: Find prescription discount prices
